attr.title: Pyro Fighters
attr.desc: Pyro Fighters is a scrolling space shooter with platforming physics. Use your flame gun to propel yourself in the air and fight through an alien army with up to four players.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into assets folder.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301370/Pyro_Fighters/) and copy all game files into `assets` folder.
